featured_reviews.name: Saurabh Srivastava
featured_reviews.review_text:
I met Sudam Sir, about 1.5 years ago. I have struggled with weight and lack of mobility for a long time. I have a chronic slip disc at 2 places. Am also, restricted from having any pain killers and anti biotics.
My asks of him haven't been extreme weight loss or muscle tone, it has been simple, I should be able to walk 5 KM non-stop and climb 7 flights of stairs, again non-stop.
He first understood my body type, its range of movement and its restrictions. Then more importantly he understood my mental make up. He modulated the training routine accordingly. It is mixed with muscle stretches, pain releiving traction, yoga, aerobics and weight training. He also does accu-pressure and stress releiving alternate therapies such as gong therapy. He forces nothing, we try and then keep what works and drop what does not.
His training has given me the cofidence to travel, knowing that I can manage the pain and more importantly function more efficiently on a day-to-day basis, being able to move more efficiently and knowing what to do to releive my muscle and bone related pain, if an episode was to occur.
I do believe that he is different, not just interested in taking me through a routine, but interested in my overall well being through exercise, diet, therapy and motivation.
Thank you Sudam Sir

Regards

Whenever I experienced pain, his acupressure techniques worked like magic — a true Midas touch. With his background in acupressure, physiotherapy, and nutrition, he brings a complete and holistic approach to fitness and healing.

Over time, I started noticing real changes — not just physically, but mentally too. I’ve become more confident, more aware of my body, and more disciplined.

Today, I can continue my exercises on my own, following his guidance. And for that, I will always be grateful.

Guruva Namah! 🙏
Thank you, Sudam Sir, for helping me rediscover my strength and faith in my own health.

If there’s one thing I’ve learned through this experience, it’s that a balanced diet and the right personal trainer can truly change your life.

I was recommended Sameer as my coach from the front desk , after I spoke to him first time over a call , i decided to start with him .
In few days , I could see myself transforming gradually . His discipline, dedication, and consistency as a coach  are truly commendable, and they reflect in the way he guides,supports and pushes his clients to become the best version of themselves. What sets him apart is , his through knowledge in exercise biomechanics, a very keen observer , highly professional, ethical and a NO NONSENSE type of person.

I really appreciate the effort and personal attention you put into every session—your knowledge, patience, and positive energy makes all the difference. You don’t just train bodies, you inspire mindsets, and that’s rare. I’m grateful for your constant encouragement, your belief in my journey, and the results we’ve been able to achieve together.

It inspires me to keep growing and improving every day. Looking forward to many more milestones with your guidance! You are truely an asset to your company . And last but not the least , u doing a fab job

featured_reviews.review_text: I made an enquiry about online training, and the entire experience was underwhelming. There was no initial call or proper discussion, responses were slow, and I was asked to make payment upfront before even speaking to a coach. The process felt overly focused on money rather than client care. Overall, the service came across as unprofessional and driven by sales rather than genuine care. It appears everything is driven by money at Tribe Fitness and therefore I wouldn’t recommend

featured_reviews.name: Niyati Gandhi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I discovered the Tribe in 2024 and signed up for group sessions and personal training.

The group workouts are challenging but designed so everyone can work at their own level. The programming is varied—you never get bored, but there's enough consistency to track real progress. The coaches emphasize proper form and scaling options for all the levels of fitness you will experience. My personal trainer Viraj is exceptional - he not only took the effort to understand and program for my fitness goals but took the effort to understand who I am and what motivates me.

Most importantly, the Tribe has helped me rediscover my love for fitness.I genuinely look forward to showing up. Whether it's the high-fives after a tough workout, the supportive messages in our group chat, runners club or the community events - UTC, Match Day - they've created something special here. The emphasis and experience of community is amazing. Any trainer who may be at the studio when you are - will help you get stronger and better. Most people you work out along side will suffer with you and laugh with you - maybe you will make a new friend.

If you're looking for more than just a place to work out—if you want a supportive community that will celebrate your victories and push you when you just cannot or don’t want to—this is your place.

featured_reviews.review_text: Tribe has been a game-changer for me, thanks to my trainer Nikhil. He’s knowledgeable, motivating, and tailors workouts to my goals. Highly recommend Tribe and Nikhil for anyone serious about fitness!
